author: reek
body: Ordering a Text is refused at CHECK. Before the refusal these operators reached a machine cmp on two POINTERS, so the answer followed allocation order: two separately built copies of "a" compared unequal and one of them was less than the other.

author: reek
body: The character case is a separate file on purpose. A refusal with more than one sufficient cause cannot be attributed to either of them, so a single test naming CDX2089 would pass with half the change reverted.
